scope: Author-requested western Old Lea industrial frontage from Three Mills to the Great Eastern Main Line, with adjacent Bow industrial ranges.
evidence: Individual envelopes read from locally archived NLS five-foot OS mapping. Site IDs and uses cross-checked against the supplied Industry_1893-95 dataset. Heights, roofs, chimneys and stock are interpreted for the flyover, not measured reconstructions.
